decisions.reason: As a newly launched handle within the firm’s core range, it should be retained because development and launch resources were just invested and there is no clear evidence yet that weak uptake is more than a temporary market effect.
This door lever handle family fits the firm’s established broad portfolio, so management would be inclined to continue with it in 2019 to justify recent investment and give the launch more time.

Because this design-oriented door handle is close to the firm’s established offer and supports its design-quality positioning, management would likely persist rather than reverse course after only one year on the market.
The product is closely related to the existing business and public market introduction has already occurred, so escalation of commitment makes continued support more likely than an early withdrawal.

As another recently introduced handle family in a firm with a broad product program, it is likely to be kept since the firm can attribute any initial disappointment to normal ramp-up and preserve consistency in its range.

The electronic access system should clearly be kept because it matches the firm’s announced move toward digital building organization, involved visible public commitment, and was presented as uniquely innovative.
